About SideTippers Australia:

SideTippers Australia is a leading Australian manufacturer of premium side tippers and heavy transport equipment, supplying innovative solutions to the mining, agricultural, civil construction and transport industries. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality workmanship, reliable products and exceptional customer service. Due to continued growth, we are seeking a skilled and motivated Welder (First Class) to join our manufacturing team in Chadwick, Western Australia.

Responsibilities:

The Welder (First Class) is responsible for the fabrication, assembly, repair and maintenance of heavy transport equipment and fabricated steel components, ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently and in accordance with engineering specifications, Australian Standards and company quality requirements.

Tasks:

•	Bring equipment, trailers and components into the workshop for fabrication, modification or repair.
•	Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications and cut lists to determine fabrication requirements.
•	Assess fabrication and repair work and plan welding and fabrication projects accurately to ensure efficient production outcomes.
•	Prepare, measure, cut, shape and align metal sections using hand tools, grinders, flame-cutting equipment and fabrication machinery.
•	Perform MIG, TIG and arc welding to manufacture, assemble, repair and modify trailers, heavy transport equipment and structural steel components.
•	Join metal sections using welding, bolting and riveting techniques where required.
•	Inspect completed welds to ensure quality, strength, penetration and compliance with engineering specifications.
•	Finish fabricated products by grinding, cleaning and polishing to achieve a high-quality finish.
•	Operate workshop equipment safely and maintain tools, machinery and equipment in good working order.
•	Work collaboratively with the workshop team to meet production schedules while maintaining a clean, organised and safe work environment.
•	Comply with all workplace health and safety procedures, company policies and quality standards.

Qualifications:

•	Trade qualification as a Welder (First Class), Engineering Tradesperson (Fabrication), or equivalent recognised qualification.
•	Current driver's licence is desirable.

Skills:

•	Proficiency in MIG, TIG and arc welding techniques.
•	Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints and technical specifications.
•	Strong fabrication, metalworking and problem-solving skills.
•	High attention to detail with a commitment to producing quality workmanship.
•	Strong organisational skills with the ability to plan and prioritise fabrication tasks effectively.
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
•	Strong commitment to workplace health and safety and safe work practices.

Experience:

•	Minimum 2 years' post-trade experience as a Welder (First Class) or in a similar fabrication role.
•	Experience manufacturing, repairing and modifying heavy machinery, trailers, transport equipment or structural steel.
•	Proven ability to work from engineering drawings and cut lists to produce accurate, high-quality fabrication work.
•	Experience operating workshop fabrication equipment and working in a heavy engineering or manufacturing environment.
•	Demonstrated ability to consistently deliver quality work while meeting production deadlines and company standards.

SALARY: $79,499 to $82,992 PER ANNUM

Reports to: Workshop Foreman / Production Manager
Job Title: Cabinet Maker
Salary range: $79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date: 30 days

About the Role:
We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Cabinetmaker for a full-time, permanent position within our client's advanced workshop. This role is central to the production of custom-made cabinets, fine furniture, and specialized commercial fit outs. The successful candidate will be responsible for interpreting complex designs and transforming premium materials into finished articles of outstanding quality, from initial fabrication through to final finishing and hardware installation.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Project Analysis & Specification Planning:
• Meticulously examine and interpret detailed workshop drawings, CAD designs, work orders, and sample components to determine precise construction specifications and methodologies.
• Select and prepare premium materials including solid timber, veneers, particle board, and specialized engineered wood products appropriate for each project's functional and aesthetic requirements.

Precision Manufacturing & Machining:
• Program, set up, and operate Computer-Aided Design (CAD) and Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machinery to accurately mark out, cut, shape, and profile components with exceptional efficiency and accuracy.
• Fabricate bespoke cabinets, freestanding furniture, and specialized fittings—including those for marine and automotive interiors—utilizing both advanced machinery and traditional hand-tool techniques to achieve fine detail.

Expert Assembly & Finishing:
• Assemble prepared components and sub-assemblies to form complete sections and finished articles, ensuring perfect alignment, structural integrity, and seamless construction.
• Skilfully apply protective and decorative finishes through sanding, staining, sealing, and coating processes to achieve a superior, client-specified surface quality on all cabinetry and furniture.

Hardware Fitting & Installation Support:
• Precisely fit and calibrate all associated hardware including hinges, locks, catches, drawer runners, and shelving systems to ensure flawless operation and longevity.
• Participate in the on-site installation and final fitting of cabinetry for kitchens, bathrooms, and commercial fit-outs, conducting necessary adjustments to ensure a perfect finish.

Specialist Fabrication & Restoration:
• Construct frames and build custom fittings for upholstered items such as chairs and couches, adhering to specific design and durability requirements.
• Potentially engage in the careful reproduction of period furniture or the expert repair and refurbishment of antique and contemporary pieces, utilizing appropriate restorative techniques.

Skills & Experience Required:
Essential Qualifications & Experience:
• A formal qualification such as a Certificate III in Cabinet Making or equivalent is essential.
• Proven post-apprenticeship experience (minimum 2+ years) within a high-end cabinetmaking, furniture manufacturing, or specialist joinery workshop environment.
• Demonstrable experience working with a broad range of materials including solid timber, veneers, and engineered boards.

Technical Proficiencies:
• High competency in programming, operating, and maintaining CNC machinery and CAD software for component production.
• Advanced skills in traditional cabinetmaking joinery, precision assembly, and hand-finishing techniques.
• Proven ability to install cabinetry and fittings on-site with a focus on precise integration.

Personal Attributes:
• An artisan's eye for detail and a steadfast commitment to producing work of the highest craftsmanship and quality.
• A methodical, problem-solving approach with the ability to work independently and manage workflow to meet deadlines.
• Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset to work effectively with workshop colleagues and design staff.
• The physical capability to handle workshop duties, including lifting materials and standing for extended periods.

What’s On Offer:
This role offers a skilled tradesperson the opportunity to work on prestigious, varied projects with premium materials in a supportive, well-resourced environment. The position comes with a permanent full-time contract and a competitive salary package reflective of experience and skill level.

Application Process:
If you possess the craftsmanship and technical skills required for this specialist cabinetmaking role, please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence.
We are acting as an exclusive recruitment agent for this position. Our client's identity is protected under our agency agreement.

Location: Multiple sites in NSW and VIC 
(Corowa 2646, Bungowannah 2640, Deniliquin 2710, Huntly 3551, St Arnaud 3478, Gre Gre 3477)
Tenure: Full-time Permanent
Comprehensive salary package from $71,481 p.a Plus superannuation


Required Skills and Experience:
•	AQF Certificate III (or higher/equivalent) qualification in Agriculture (Pig Production);
•	At least 3 years recent relevant experience in a medium to large size commercial piggery

Position Summary:
On behalf of our client, Global Skilled Employment Services is looking for a skilled and experienced Senior Piggery Stockperson who can join the production team of a piggery company with multiple farm sites.

Must have strong communication and time management skills, self-motivated and
must have the ability to work independently and as a member of a team.

Tasks and duties include:
•	Supervise the site and facilities in terms of the required human resources, physical resources, safety requirements, consumables, documentation and measurement devices
•	Provide overall maintenance and compliance of the Company Quality
•	Assurance program for the site ensuring that all relevant documentation is kept current;
•	Supervise data collection and recording so information is accurate to aid stock and inventory control
•	Undertake specific tasks assigned by management to ensure that environmental, quality and safety goals are met
•	Implement preventable maintenance programs to reduce planned and unplanned down time
•	Supervise trial sheds, collect and record data in accordance with trial protocols
•	Selection of breeding stock and/or pigs for sale
•	Supervision and participation of daily inspection of livestock, such that the animals are appropriately fed, watered, environmental parameters are fulfilled.
•	The Senior Stockperson (Piggery) in this case would work with and supervise a less experienced Stockperson
•	Supervision and participation of daily inspection of livestock, ensuring compromised animals are individually assessed, identified, treated and record in accordance with the Company Herd Health Plan and the industries Model Code of Practice
•	Euthanise sick or injured stock in a humane manner and in accordance with the Model Code of Practice for Animal Welfare – Pigs 3rd edition
•	Conduct post mortem examinations of deceased stock and report findings
•	Supervision and participation in the mating of animals via individually supervised mating or through Artificial Insemination
•	Supervision of the birthing process, including the ability to physically conduct unsupervised internal assessments of females during parturition to minimise this incidence of still births
•	Participate in company/industry training sessions and workshops as required;
•	Perform any other duty as required by the Unit Manager.

Other skills required:
•	Good verbal and written communication skills;
•	Advanced and extensive knowledge in animal husbandry, animal welfare, and pig production;
•	Knowledge in using computer system is an advantage.

result.description:
About the Opportunity  
 Are you an experienced Project Manager with a strong background in electrical installations, switchboard/MCC integration, or utility infrastructure? 
 We are a leading electrical engineering specialist delivering critical infrastructure projects across the water, wastewater, energy, and industrial sectors.   We are seeking a Project Manager to take end-to-end ownership of major site-based electrical installations, low-voltage infrastructure upgrades, and associated control system integrations. 
 This role is ideal for a delivery-focused leader who excels at managing site installation crews, subcontractors, and complex operational cutovers in live utility environments (Water infrastructure / Treatment plants / Pump station). 
  Key Responsibilities  
 
 
  Electrical Installation Management:  Oversee full site-based electrical installation works-including LV power distribution, switchboard/Motor Control Centre (MCC) replacements, cabling, instrumentation, and site infrastructure upgrades. 
 
 
  Full-Lifecycle Project Delivery:  Drive projects from initial design and procurement through FAT/SAT testing, site construction, energisation, commissioning, and final operational handover. 
 
 
  Site & Operational Leadership:  Lead multidisciplinary site teams, electrical trades, and subcontractors within live, high-risk operational environments where safety, reliability, and strict shutdown schedules are paramount. 
 
 
  Technical & Quality Compliance:  Ensure all works comply strictly with AS/NZS 3000 (Wiring Rules), AS/NZS 61439, and relevant utility safety, quality, and environmental standards (HSEQ). 
 
 
  Commercial & Client Delivery:  Manage project budgets, variations, schedules, and supply chain procurement, acting as the primary point of contact for clients and asset owners. 
 
 
  About You  
 
 
  Experience:  Managing complex electrical installation and infrastructure projects. 
 
 
  Technical Background:  Deep experience in low-voltage electrical distribution, switchboards/MCCs, site wiring, and field instrumentation (experience with interfacing SCADA/PLC systems is highly regarded). 
 
 
  Site Execution:  Proven track record leading live operational cutovers, brownfield upgrades, and shutdown-constrained installation work on utility or industrial sites. 
 
 
  Safety First Mindset:  Strong commitment to HSEQ compliance, risk management, and safe working methodologies (SWMS/LOTOs) on physical job sites. 
 
 
  Qualifications:  Electrical Trade qualification (A-Grade) or Degree in Electrical Engineering. Formal Project Management certification (PMP/Prince2) is advantageous. 
 
 

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background. 
   
    Please  click here  to apply.
